conditionalTest.eligibility: matched terminal generic-gate proxy = handlingLive + passingDead + handlingDead + offensiveFoul + otherViolation; both handlingLive and dead aggregate baseline-real pooled franchise+seed95 lower bound >0, and real unmapped share of pre-attempt turnovers <=5%. Otherwise stop after diagnosis: one scalar not justified
conditionalTest.scalar: single league multiplier = pooled all-anchor real matched-generic incidence / baseline matched-generic incidence, four-season equal weight; strictly positive and <1. No scoring/wins search; approximation of incidence to a gate multiplier, not identified event hazard
conditionalTest.scope: generic terminal touch risk only while after player FG OREB and before first FG or ordinary FT; maintain through ordinary nonshooting fouls; reset at possession end, FG, FT, period. Same RNG draw and live/dead category mix. Passing interception, independent clock, fouls, cards, rebound, timing and pace unchanged
conditionalTest.sampleSize: 3seed diagnostic; if guard fails reject. No baseline adoption without separate20seed paired test
conditionalTest.guard: matched category incidence should move toward truth; combined postOREB live/dead category squared error must fall, FT excess must not increase significantly; any inconsistency is failure not compensated via other parameters
